name: Billy Doe Meats
verdict: For Billy Doe Meats, the biggest movement is a 29.29% drop in Google Business Profile actions over the last 7 days (against 596 total GBP actions in the 28-day window), likely driven by reduced local search visibility or seasonal dip in foot traffic intent. On a positive note, GA4 sessions are up 5.47%, suggesting the website itself is holding steady with slight organic or direct traffic growth.

performance.verdict: Ads are dark; organic holding but 5 SOW milestones overdue.

findings.text: Paid spend is $0 across all channels for the entire 45-day series — no Meta, no Google, no purchases, no ROAS to evaluate.
OVERDUE (Aug 14): Live-Cooking Event Shoot 1 not completed; real facility footage delivered Jul 21 but no shoot event recorded.
OVERDUE (Aug 31): Pre-Launch Gate, Platform Ownership Decision, Funnel Test Closed + UTM Live, and SEO Phase 1 Guardrails — 4 milestones all missed on same date.
GBP actions dropped -29.29% last 7 days; 3-day signal (Aug 28–30: 33+33+0 vs Aug 25–27: 35+16+37) shows the Aug 31 zero is a data gap, not a true collapse.
GA4 sessions averaged 383 on Sep 1–2 vs 252 the prior 3 days (Aug 28–30) — a +52% 3-day uptick with zero paid spend driving it.

suggestions.text: Unblock paid launch: confirm Meta campaign is built and funded before next check on 2026-09-06.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend has been $0 for 45 consecutive days — no ROAS, no purchases, no data to optimise against. The SOW renewal started Aug 1 with ~$1,000–1,500/mo ad spend budgeted. Nacer (Ops) to confirm with Sohib whether the Meta campaign is built, funded, and approved to go live. Success check: at least 1 day of non-zero Meta spend recorded by 2026-09-06.

suggestions.text: Close the 4 Aug 31 overdue milestones or formally defer with new dates — blocks attribution and launch.
suggestions.monday_update: Four milestones missed their Aug 31 deadline: Pre-Launch Gate, Platform Ownership Decision, Funnel Test Closed + UTM Live, and SEO Phase 1 Guardrails. These are not independent — UTM Live and the funnel test directly block reliable attribution once ads go live. Nacer to get a status and a new committed date from each dept owner by 2026-09-06. Success check: all 4 items have either a completed event logged or a revised date in Monday by 2026-09-06.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP Aug 31 zero — confirm data gap vs real drop before any local action; re-check 2026-09-06.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions show 0 on Aug 31 but averaged 33 on Aug 28–30, making the Aug 31 read a likely reporting gap rather than a real drop. The 7-day delta of -29.29% is inflated by this zero. Pull the GBP dashboard directly for Aug 31 and Sep 1–2 to confirm. If the zero is confirmed real, escalate as a local visibility issue; if it is a data gap, close this item. Re-check by 2026-09-06.
